name: Xtreme Fighting Championships, Inc.
summary: Xtreme Fighting Championships, Inc. operates as a leading sports entertainment and media enterprise, primarily focusing on the professional mixed martial arts (MMA) circuit. The company is responsible for orchestrating and promoting live XFC fighting events, which feature a diverse lineup of male and female MMA athletes competing across all major weight categories. These high-octane events are broadcast to a global audience via traditional television networks, pay-per-view services, and various online streaming platforms. Beyond staging competitive bouts, Xtreme Fighting Championships, Inc. also invests in developing fighter talent, and it devises advertising and sponsorship programs to extend the reach of its live events across broadcast and social media channels. Furthermore, the company creates and distributes branded merchandise, aiming to bolster its XFC brand recognition among consumers and dedicated MMA enthusiasts. Originally founded in 2006 as Duke Mountain Resources, Inc., the organization officially adopted the name Xtreme Fighting Championships, Inc. in July 2020. Its corporate headquarters are located in Miramar Beach, Florida.
